title: Classic pcap's magic number encodes both endianness and time precision simultaneously
summary: Magic bytes d4 c3 b2 a1 indicate little-endian microseconds and 4d 3c b2 a1 indicate little-endian nanoseconds. Reverse each sequence for big-endian.
applies: Legacy libpcap format; single interface capture
detail: The subsequent seconds field and decimal part use file-endian order, and the dimension of the decimal part is determined by the magic number.
boundary: pcapng uses a different structure and cannot apply this four-value rule to interpret its packet timestamps.
relevance: Prevent the gap between adjacent packets from being enlarged or reduced by a thousand times when replaying the offline timeline.
